result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The related tests pass: `RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `TicketsPerRegionTest` (12 tests, 0 failures).

The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. `findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` now calls `.highestPriorityFirst()` on its query, the same way the sales-rep list does, and its javadoc says so. That method has one caller, `RegionManagerService.overviewFor`, so nothing else changes. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

I did not commit anything.
